checks.evidence: Directly inspected all three option sheets against adult reference ea8cf733...: warm medium complexion, gently angular oval face, defined jaw, rounded chin, dark-brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, rounded nose, softly full lips, short black hair with close sides and raised swept-back top, neatly trimmed dark beard connected to moustache, rust-red textured crew-neck sweater, silver chain, dark watch, dark trousers preserved as simplified sculpted animation geometry in all 12 cells of each option.
checks.location: All 4 turnarounds and 8 portraits in options 0,1,2 vs adult reference

checks.evidence: Stylized Pixar-like 3D feature animation in all options: simplified appealing shapes, enlarged expressive head and eyes, broad soft facial planes, smooth matte skin with no photographic pores/blemishes/fine wrinkles/stubble, sculpted hair/beard masses with soft shading, tactile knit, soft cinematic lighting on neutral grey. Not photoreal or photoreal/3D hybrid, not 2D/anime/clay/sketch. No baked-in text, labels, captions, numbers or watermarks observed.

Quick full-view pass over every figure: two arms, two legs, natural joints, normal-looking hands with no clearly visible extra/missing limbs, fused or extra fingers, broken joints or floating extremities; eyes align naturally, mouth interiors render cleanly. Some fingers too small to count but nothing looks wrong, which is a pass; no crop needed.
checks.location: Hands, limbs, faces in all turnaround and portrait cells options 0,1,2

checks.evidence: Each option shows exactly four equal-scale neutral full-body figures on common baseline in order front, three-quarter ~45deg, profile 90deg, back 180deg with arms relaxed slightly away, empty hands; every figure fully inside its cell with margins above hairstyle and below soles, head, both hands, legs and complete footwear uncropped; rust-red sweater continued coherently over back; watch/chain placement shows no clear side-switch under character-own-side rule.

Each option shows exactly eight head-and-shoulder portraits in two rows of four with distinct readable acting: middle row neutral closed lips, warm smile lifted cheeks, broad delighted joy smile, focused concentration, bottom row firm resolve, raised-brow parted-lip surprise, pinched-inner-brow concern, one-raised-brow asymmetrical mischief; no duplicate neutral/surprise, no extra columns or repeated views.

Within each option, adult face, complexion, hairstyle, beard, body proportions, rust-red sweater knit, dark trousers, sneakers, silver chain and dark watch remain identical across all 4 turnarounds and 8 portraits; no alternate age, outfit change or proportion drift; portrait crops retain same identity and garment.

recommendation.reason: Option 1 best preserves reference thick silver chain visibly in all portraits plus rust sweater, watch, hair/beard and clean turnaround/expression layout; options 2 and 0 match but show chain faintly or cropped in portraits.
